subject: english
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.

It grew colder and colder still, and fine, (powdery snow began to fall), so that soon we and all around us were covered with a white blanket.

options.text: powdery snow has began to fall
powdery snow has been began to fall

solution: The correct answer is** Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given phrase **"powdery snow began to fall"** is **correct** and does not require any modification. • **Meaning: **The action of snow starting to fall in a fine, powdery form. (बारीक पाउडर जैसी बर्फ गिरने लगी) • **"Began"** is the past tense of **"begin**," indicating that the action started at some point in the past. (शुरू हुआ) • **Example: **The meeting** began** at 10 AM. Therefore, the correct answer is: **No correction required**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Powdery snow begun on fall **(बारीक पाउडर जैसी बर्फ गिरना शुरू हो गया): This phrase is grammatically incorrect. "Begun" is the past participle and should be used with "has" or "have." • **Example: Incorrect**: The work begun yesterday. Correct: The work has begun yesterday. • **Powdery snow has began to fall **(बारीक पाउडर जैसी बर्फ गिरने लगी है): This phrase is also incorrect. "Began" is the simple past form and should not be used with "has." • **Example: Incorrect**: The event has began. Correct: The event has begun. • **Powdery snow has been began to fall** (बारीक पाउडर जैसी बर्फ गिरने लगी है): This phrase is incorrect. "Has been" should be followed by a present participle (verb+ing), not the past tense. • **Example: Incorrect**: The work has been began. Correct: The work has been beginning. 30:Tc2d, The correct answer is** Option 1)**
